newsitem.title: FRANCE: ALPINE SKIING-GERG SEIZES SUPER-G AHEAD OF SEIZINGER.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-GERG SEIZES SUPER-G AHEAD OF SEIZINGER.

text.p: Germany's new Alpine skiing hope Hilde Gerg came in ahead of compatriot Katja Seizinger, the World Cup champion and current leader, to steal a women's super-G race on Thursday.
Gerg, third behind Seizinger in the same race at Val d'Isere last season, was the only racer to complete the course in under one minute eight seconds.
Her time of 1:07.81 was almost 40 hundredths of a second faster than her second-placed compatriot.
Super-G world champion Isolde Kostner of Italy, second in last year's race, was third.
It was Gerg's second World Cup victory after a super-G win at Sierre Nevada in 1994.
The start was held up for half an hour when a front runner crashed into three photographers and had to be taken to hospital at nearby Bourg Saint-Maurice.
